description:
This agreement between the National Public Prosecutor’s Office (NPO) and Texas A&M University (TAMU) funds a disaster modeling project under the direction of a TAMU faculty member who receives salary support for his effort on the project.  No other TAMU personnel or students are engaged under the contract work.  Scenario modeling is being performed by external subcontractors who otherwise have no connection to TAMU and are not educational institutions.  Submission of quarterly progress reports and a final report are required by the sponsor.

On January 2, 2022, NPO and TAMU executed a Memorandum of Understanding that extends the contract by an additional 12 months.  Under the extended terms, TAMU will receive another $2,063,816 in additions to the $2,584,619 reported in the previous periods for a total contract amount of $4,648,435.  All other contract terms remained unchanged.

This contract was entered into agreement March 28, 2019.  Texas A&M is reporting the full amount of the contract during this reporting cycle (January 2020 – June 2020).  In previous reporting cycles, Texas A&M reported payments received during each 6-month reporting cycle as National Public Prosecutor’s Office.  As a result, there may be over-reporting for this agreement, as portions of the total amount have previously been reported.  Individual payments received under this agreement will no longer be reported.
